data.explanation: This letter is a legally required summary of your new mobile phone contract in Germany. It confirms your tariff, monthly price, minimum contract length and how to cancel later (1 month's notice at the end of the minimum term, then anytime with 1 month's notice). No action is needed now — just keep this document, as you'll need the details later if you want to cancel or switch providers. The full terms (AGB) are available in the customer portal.
